name: Venture Co. Base Camp
summary: In northern Stranglethorn, Venture Co. Base Camp cuts into the jungle. Goblin overseers and laborers harvest timber, hunt wildlife, and search nearby waterways for tumbled crystals.

sections.title: Industrial Encroachment
sections.body: Venture Co. Base Camp sends crews into the jungle for profit. Steam-powered machines and rough goblin shacks break through the ancient canopy. Armed mercenaries guard the camp. Foremen and workers direct the gathering of resources across nearby valleys. They search the waterways for tumbled crystals and clear jungle that blocks their work.

faq.q: What is the Venture Company doing in Stranglethorn Vale?
faq.answer: The Venture Company logs northern Stranglethorn's dense jungle, builds heavy operations, and gathers valuable minerals. Tumbled crystals from nearby waterways are among its prizes.

faq.q: Are the goblins here affiliated with the Steamwheedle Cartel in Booty Bay?
aliases: are they friendly to booty bay
faq.answer: No. The Venture Company is separate from Baron Revilgaz and the Steamwheedle Cartel. Booty Bay's merchants build trade ties, while the Venture Company exploits the land and turns hostile toward those who hinder its profits.

faq.q: What lies beyond the base camp?
aliases: what is adjacent to base camp
faq.answer: The Venture Co. Operations Center lies beside the base camp. Its logging machinery, lumber stores, and company managers direct the clearing of jungle across the region.

angles.text: As a druid, you see the Venture Company tear into jungle habitats and disturb nature's balance with crude machinery.
As a miner, you find company prospectors searching the jungle for raw materials and rare tumbled crystals.
